answer: Start every identity at the nadir of trust with 40 unlinkable action tokens a day, issued blind. Needing more means climbing a ridge of prices: each extra block of 10 tokens costs 25 tokens, doubling per block, so 200 clones burn 5000 tokens a day to keep pace. Unspent tokens melt after 24 hours, and each morning the allowance is re-issued under a fresh quill-signed key, so no stockpile survives the night.
